page.notes: Hebrew words are copied as closely as the scan allows; vowel points and dagesh marks on small type are uncertain, so the Hebrew errata lines are doubtful in detail. Marked [?]: the Hebrew on Pag.108 lin.6 and the two Hebrew forms on Pag.111. The Latin is clear. The "eraria" on Pag.108 lin.30 has a possibly Cyrillic-looking a; read as Latin a. Printing errors left as printed, including "esset" for the printed word, which is an uncertain reading.
